assessments.reasoning: The SDC technical memorandum title names C. J. Shaw, Part 2 Revision 1, its exact report number and 9 June 1961. The cover requests prior permission for quoting or reproduction. The fresh PDF hash and every associated raw page, image and content object range match. The cited physical pages were rerendered and inspected at 139 dpi. The displayed passage at TM-555/002/01, Assignment Statement Form 070, printed pp. 36–37 / PDF pp. 39–40; Preface, printed p. 1 / PDF p. 4 addresses the proposition. On printed p. 36, Form 070 starts arithmetic assignment. Its continuation on p. 37 marks a negative value assigned to an unsigned variable as undefined. The preface explains that the effects of undefined constructions depend on the computer. The assessment stays within the named dated SDC document and its scope. It assesses documentary wording, not execution on a specific implementation. The undefined sentence directly addresses the exact negative-to-unsigned case. Statements on precision loss and non-arithmetic representation do not give it a deterministic outcome or diagnostic. A diagnostic may occur, but the source does not make that universal. This concerns the attempted arithmetic assignment.
